text:
katherine: Heads up — saw a PagerDuty alert that included request headers in the attached incident log. Looks like x-user-id and an authorization header showed up. Can someone scope quickly?
jasper: :eyes: Which file/alert? PD webhook or our consumer?
oncall-bot: Incident created: PD-4621 — pager: header_leak — 1769257890
katherine: PD webhook -> /internal/incidents. The PD payload JSON had `headers: { \"x-user-id\": \"user_1234\", \"authorization\": \"Bearer sk_live_abc123\" }`. I masked a bit here.
elena: If that's a live secret we need rotate now. Can you paste the exact snippet (masked) and timestamp?
katherine: pasted below (masked):
```
"headers": { "x-user-id": "user_1234", "authorization": "Bearer sk_live_***" }
```
jasper: I can run a quick grep across the S3 archive. Will check for unmasked occurrences.
jasper: ran `gzgrep -n \"authorization\" /mnt/logs/* | head` — hits in `incidents/2026-02-24/pd-4621.json` and a few rotated files.
ryan: Who has access to that S3 bucket? Is it publicly reachable?
elena: Only infra-admins + security-team. Not public, but leakage of tokens still needs rotation and audit.
katherine: My read: PD usually masks some headers but our webhook formatter didn't strip before archiving. Action items: scope logs (jasper), rotate any full tokens (elena), craft comms/notify legal if needed (ryan).
jasper: scope update: found 4 entries referencing authorization. 3 are masked, 1 has an unmasked full token at 2026-02-24T18:12:03Z in `incidents/2026-02-24/pd-4621.json`.
elena: initiating immediate rotation for the exposed token. Filing rotation ticket now: infra/kms rotations #1547. Will update when complete.
ryan: For external comms — legal asked for a short factual summary. @katherine can you draft a 1–2 sentence statement for legal review? Include mitigation and customer impact (if any).
katherine: Draft for legal review:
"We detected that an internal incident webhook logged a raw authorization header for a single internal API token. The token was rotated within 15 minutes and no customer data or access was affected. We are updating log redaction rules and webhook formatting to prevent recurrence."
jasper: LGTM. Also raised PR to add redaction to the webhook consumer: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/890
elena: Rotation in progress :lock: Will confirm once new key is live and old key is revoked.
katherine: I'm granting go-ahead to send the draft to legal for their sign-off. Tagging @legal-team. Any objections?
ryan: None from me. :+1:
oncall-bot: Incident PD-4621 status updated: mitigated — rotated tokens, redaction PR merged (env:prod)
katherine: Thanks all. We'll add this to the postmortem and follow up with a short blameless write-up. cc: @security
